Direction basis for Irrep_X3- (degeneracy 2):

Position 1: arm axis (no within-arm freedom on this arm), arm 1 (native) -- Irrep_<label>/POSCAR_superlattice
Position 2: arm axis (no within-arm freedom on this arm), arm 2 -- Directions/Cell_2/POSCAR_superlattice

Positions sharing an arm share the SAME cell -- a pure rotation of the pattern on that cell's own POSCAR_superlattice, nothing structural changes. Positions on different arms need their own cell (a genuinely different star arm, see `star X3-`).
